title: Mandragora Fisalia
wikitext:
{{NPC Infobox |affiliation = Fisalia Family |status = deceased/MIA }} {{Spoiler}} Mandragora Fisalia was the eldest daughter of the main line of the Fisalia family. She was the older sister of [[Hebenon Fisalia]] and the older cousin of [[Cantarella Fisalia]]. She disappeared during the Divine Trials, alongside Hebenon.
After resolving the mystery in {{Quest|A Fleeting Night's Dream}}, the truth of what happened to the missing girls are revealed. ==Dialogue== {{Dialogue Start}} ;(Found at Port Riccioli amongst [[Riccioli Islands]]) :'''"Mandra":''' I never imagined life could feel this carefree. :'''"Mandra":''' Just look at this vast scenery... It brings much calm to my heart. :'''"Hebe": Yeah, I feel the same way. A simple and quiet life. There's a beauty in it. :'''"Hebe": We have Cantarella to thank for this peace. :'''"Mandra":''' I feel reassured with her as the head of our family. :'''"Mandra":''' She's... she's everything a Maiden should be, more so than I could ever be. And as the head of Fisalia? She's unmatched. :'''"Mandra":''' For us, I think it's our turn to make the most of the world she saved for us. Let's live every day to its fullest. :'''"Hebe": Yes, and let's capture the beauty we find along the way! I'm sure she'll be happy to receive these photos! {{Dialogue End}}
